        s = "What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?"
    else:
        s = f'What are you doing while sending "{get_nth_char(n-1, k)}"? Are you busy? Will you send "{get_nth_char(n-1, k)}"?'
    
    # Adjust k to zero-indexed
    k -= 1
    
    # Calculate the length of the string without quotes
    len_without_quotes = len(s.replace('"', ''))
    
    # If k is within the bounds of the string without quotes
    if k < len_without_quotes:
        return s[k]
    else:
        # Otherwise, calculate the position within the quotes
        inner_string_len = (len_without_quotes - 2 * s.count('"')) // 2
        quote_position = k % inner_string_len
        return '"' + s[quote_position] + '"'
